summary: Google AI Studio supports browser-based image generation and has a free, rate-limited tier. Official billing says AI Studio stays free unless a paid API key is linked for paid features. Free image access is model-dependent: current image API pricing has no free tier, and the public-source check did not confirm which current browser image model works without billing. Check the authenticated model's free/paid notice before generating; linking a paid key can incur charges. No specific free quota or campaign end date is established.
claim_steps: Sign in with a Google account.
Check the image-model selector's free/paid notice; proceed only if that browser model offers free access without a paid API key. Do not assume every image model is free.
Respect the model-specific displayed limits; linking a paid API key for paid features can incur charges.
